import MilneLib.Sheaf.LinearizedInvariantSheafOverlap
import MilneLib.Sheaf.RestrictionCoherence

/-!
# Coherence of invariant-sheaf transitions

On a self-overlap, both affine comparisons use the same invariant module.
Their cancellation identifies the transition with the canonical restriction
comparison for the identity scheme transition.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

universe u

open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry
open MilneLib.GaloisDescent.SemilinearAction
open MilneLib.StableGroupAction.ModuleLinearization

namespace MilneLib.StableGroupAction.StableAffineOpen

variable {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
  [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]
  {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.IsSeparated]
  {act : (L ≃ₐ[K] L) →* Aut X}
  (p : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L))
  (hact : ∀ g : L ≃ₐ[K] L,
    (act g).hom ≫ p = p ≫ (specAction (L ≃ₐ[K] L) L g).hom)
  {F : X.Modules} [F.IsQuasicoherent] (D : ModuleLinearization act F)
  (i : StableAffineOpen act)

local notation "pK" => p ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))
local notation "hK" => galois_action_comp_base act p hact

set_option maxHeartbeats 800000 in
-- Cancellation unfolds the dependent fixed-ring structures of both chart comparisons.
/-- The diagonal invariant-sheaf transition is the canonical comparison
between restriction along an inclusion and along the self-swap followed by
that inclusion. -/
theorem linearizedInvariantSheafTransitionIso_self :
    letI := sectionsAlgebra pK i.U
    letI := sectionsAlgebra p i.U
    letI := sections_isScalarTower K L p i.U
    letI := sectionsMulSemiringAction act i.stable
    letI := isSemilinear_sections K L act p hact i.stable
    letI := sectionsSMulCommClass act pK hK i.stable
    letI := D.sectionsDistribMulAction i.stable
    letI := D.sectionsSMulDistribClass i.stable
    let q := quotientOverlapι act pK hK i i
    let s := (quotientOverlapSwapIso act pK hK i i).hom
    let N := tilde (ModuleCat.of
      (CommRingCat.of (FixedPoints.subalgebra K Γ(X, i.U) (L ≃ₐ[K] L)))
      (invariantModule K L Γ(X, i.U) Γ(F, i.U)))
    linearizedInvariantSheafTransitionIso p hact D i i =
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr
        (show q = s ≫ q by simp [s, quotientOverlapSwapIso_self])).app N ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp s q).app N := by
  letI := sectionsAlgebra pK i.U
  letI := sectionsAlgebra p i.U
  letI := sections_isScalarTower K L p i.U
  letI := sectionsMulSemiringAction act i.stable
  letI := isSemilinear_sections K L act p hact i.stable
  letI := sectionsSMulCommClass act pK hK i.stable
  letI := D.sectionsDistribMulAction i.stable
  letI := D.sectionsSMulDistribClass i.stable
  letI := sectionsAlgebra pK (i.U ⊓ i.U)
  letI := sectionsMulSemiringAction act (overlap_stable act i i)
  letI := sectionsSMulCommClass act pK hK (overlap_stable act i i)
  letI : IsOpenImmersion (fixedSectionsRestrictionMap act pK hK i.stable
      (overlap_stable act i i) inf_le_left) :=
    overlapFixedRestrictionMap_isOpenImmersion act pK hK i i
  dsimp only
  unfold linearizedInvariantSheafTransitionIso linearizedInvariantSheafQuotientOverlapIso
  apply Iso.ext
  simp only [Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom, Category.assoc,
    ← Functor.map_comp_assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id]
  erw [CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id, Category.id_comp, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
  rw [← Category.assoc, cancel_mono]
  exact congrArg Iso.hom (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr_trans _ _ _)

end MilneLib.StableGroupAction.StableAffineOpen
